variables.name: DISCARD_STREAM_TIMEOUT_MILLIS
variables.comment:
* The timeout to use while discarding a stream of input data. Since this is
   * used for connection reuse, this timeout should be significantly less than
   * the time it takes to establish a new connection.

methods.name: Sink createRequestBody(Request request, long contentLength) throws IOException
methods.comment: Returns an output stream where the request body can be streamed.

methods.name: void writeRequestHeaders(Request request) throws IOException
methods.comment: This should update the HTTP engine's sentRequestMillis field.

methods.name: void writeRequestBody(RetryableSink requestBody) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Sends the request body returned by {@link #createRequestBody} to the
   * remote peer.

methods.name: void finishRequest() throws IOException
methods.comment: Flush the request to the underlying socket.

methods.name: ResponseBody openResponseBody(Response response) throws IOException
methods.comment: Returns a stream that reads the response body.

methods.name: void cancel()
methods.comment:
* Cancel this stream. Resources held by this stream will be cleaned up, though not synchronously.
   * That may happen later by the connection pool thread.
